inference_protocol.note: The paper does not state inference settings; these are the repository values for this run (exp_setting.md E1.3). num_inference_steps=1 is a smoke setting and must not be reported as a result.

protocol.depth: decoded RGB to metric depth with curve=metric_power (paper Eq.1); log_relative is an opt-in relative ablation and must not be cited as paper AbsRel; GT validity/crop masks plus historical finite-positive prediction filtering after any clipping (not fixed-GT support); NYU Eigen crop + 10m cap / KITTI Garg crop + 80m cap / ETH3D 80m cap / nuScenes 80m cap (no paper crop) when those datasets are named; DIODE has no cap; AbsRel_aligned/delta_1.25_aligned are per-image median-scale diagnostics, not paper protocol; *_per_image keys are means of per-image metrics (headline keys are pixel-weighted); crop/cap/aggregation are conventions, not paper-disclosed
protocol.normal: decoded RGB to unit camera-space normals; valid pixels are finite, non-zero GT (plus DIODE mask when present); mean_angle_deg_per_image is the mean of per-image means; NYU/ScanNet require community normal maps; VKITTI2 ships no normals, so VirtualKITTINormalDataset derives them from its centimetre depth + intrinsic.txt in the paper frame (used only to build GT, never as model input); DIODE is indoors
protocol.semantic: decoded RGB to class labels; Cityscapes labelIds mapped to trainIds; global confusion matrix; official gtFine only, never cityscapes8; with --native-resolution the canvas is decoded first and the label map nearest-upsampled to the 2048x1024 GT (interpolating RGB would blend boundary colours into phantom classes)
protocol.referring: RefCOCOg requires refs(umd).p with no protocol fallback and validates images, expressions, and nonempty native COCO polygon/RLE masks using pycocotools; ReasonSeg val uses LISA JSON-next-to-image; annotation mode is explicit: legacy_union preserves historical labels, lisa_v1 skips flag and excludes ignore=255 with official area-ordered OpenCV rasterization; one sample per expression, ReasonSeg expands all queries by default (first is an explicit historical option); gIoU/IoU is the equal-weight mean over queries, cIoU is summed intersection / summed union over queries; no image-level averaging; paper ReasonSeg gIoU includes a Gemini 2.5 Pro rewrite that this command does not run unless rewritten_text is already in the JSON
protocol.instance: SA-Co/Gold query JSONL when present, else color/instance pairs; cgF1 = 100 * pmF1 * IL_MCC; paper IL_MCC uses Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite presence filtering, which this command does not invent
protocol.generation: paper GenAI-Bench / ImgEdit numbers are human pairwise win rates; this command only scores an optional CLIP/FID proxy when images exist and never writes those proxies into the paper win-rate column
protocol.aggregation: task-specific global accumulators over the selected dataset; referring gIoU is query-weighted and cIoU is cumulative intersection / union, not batch mean
